Items.Name: A-10C Thunderbolt II
Items.Description: A highly durable attacker with heavy weaponry designed for close air support. Its agility at low speeds and its air-to-ground weaponry—including 30mm machine guns—help it prove its worth in battle. Its nickname is "Thunderbolt II."

Items.Name: F-2A
Items.Description: A multirole aircraft based on the F-16. Designed with its country's needs in mind, it shows its greatest strength in interdictions at sea, and can hold its own in aerial combat. Its unofficial nickname is "Viper Zero."

Items.Name: F-4E Phantom II
Items.Description: A large fighter aircraft developed for carrier and land. The E-model is a variant with additional fixed armaments used by the air force. Nicknamed "Phantom II", it set numerous speed records after it was developed.

Items.Name: F-15C Eagle
Items.Description: A large twin-engine air superiority fighter that boasts excellent performance. Nicknamed "Eagle," it has great speed, maneuverability, and endurance, allowing it to dominate the skies.

Items.Name: F-22A Raptor
Items.Description: A stealth fighter developed as part of the Advanced Tactical Fighter program. Its weapons systems are housed in internal bays to maintain low detectability. Through its high maneuverability and integrated information systems it boasts overwhelming superiority in air combat.

Items.Name: F-35C Lightning II
Items.Description: A multirole fighter with stealth capabilities, the C-model is a carrier-based aircraft flown by the navy. Developed as part of the JSF (Joint Strike Fighter) program, it can be configured for a variety of both air-to-air and ground attack mission profiles. Its nickname is "Lightning II."

Items.Name: F/A-18C Hornet
Items.Description: An improved version of an early F/A-18 carrier-based attacker model. Known as "Hornet," this C-model features improved engine thrust and enhanced radar abilities. It is able to operate a wide array of air-to-air missiles, as well as anti-ground and anti-ship weaponry.

Items.Name: Gripen E
Items.Description: Gripen E is a multi-role fighter designed to defeat any adversary. Gripen E incorporates cutting edge technologies using the latest systems, sensors and weapons ensure combat advantage, delivering Air Superiority in highly contested environments.

Items.Name: Su-34 Fullback
Items.Description: A large fighter-bomber developed on the basis of the Su-27. Heavily armed, armored, and capable of high speeds, it is also equipped with a more than adequate air-to-air self-defense armament. It is known by the codename "Fullback."

Items.Name: EA-18G Growler
Items.Description: An EW attacker based on the F/A-18F, developed as a successor to the EA-6B. Known as "Growler," it is defined by its blend of attack capabilities, and is also outfitted with air-to-air missiles for self-defense.

Items.Name: Typhoon
Items.Description: A multirole fighter jointly developed by multiple countries. Nicknamed "Typhoon," its delta wings ensure stability, and its powerful armament can take on all types of enemy craft.

Items.Name: F-15J Eagle
Items.Description: A variant of the F-15C, created outside the original developer's country. Featuring updated avionics and the ability to carry new types of high-performance guided missiles, it perfects an impenetrable defense of the skies. Like the F-15C, its nickname is "Eagle."

Items.Name: A-6E Intruder
Items.Description: A carrier-based attacker designed to execute precise attacks regardless of the weather. Nicknamed "Intruder," it boasts updates to enhanced abilities such as pinpoint attacks and low altitude intrusions from the combat data it has accrued.

Items.Name: A-6E Intruder
Items.Description: A carrier-based attacker designed to execute precise attacks regardless of the weather. Nicknamed "Intruder," it boasts updates to enhanced abilities such as pinpoint attacks and low altitude intrusions from the combat data it has accrued.

Items.Name: Rafale M
Items.Description: A twin-engine fighter with "delta-canard" wings and digital controls. The Rafale M is a fully multirole fighter, capable of performing all types of combat missions (air-to-air, air-to-ground, air-to-sea), from an airbase or from an aircraft carrier. Its nickname is "Rafale", meaning "gust of wind."

Items.Name: Su-25SM Frogfoot
Items.Description: An attack aircraft specialized in close air support ground attacks. It boasts high survivability owing to its stout airframe and titanium armour. Its nickname is "Frogfoot."

Items.Name: X-40 Nightmare
Items.Description: A large tailless stealth fighter that was developed as part of the DOE (Darkness of Enigma) project. It carries 4 combat-ready UAVs. Despite its overwhelming size, it is capable of excellent maneuverability and climbing performance due to its dedicated thrust-vectoring engines. Its nickname is "Nightmare."

Items.Name: Mirage 2000-5
Items.Description: A light fighter with delta wings and no horizontal tail wing. The 2000-5 is a multirole fighter whose well balanced speed and maneuverability and fly-by-wire controls provide it with inherently excellent flying stability. Its nickname is "Mirage."

Items.Name: FA-36 Game
Items.Description: A tailless stealth carrier-based aircraft that features high maneuverability and diverse armament capabilities. Its twin engines are designed for operational stability, while the use of 3D thrust-vectoring engines and variable wings ensure a high level of mobility during combat. Its nickname is "Game," which is derived from game fowl.

Items.Name: EA-36 Barricader
Items.Description: An EW aircraft based on the FA-36 Game. The majority of its system operations are automated, eliminating the need for dedicated EW personnel. Its nickname is "Barricader."

Items.Name: MiG-29A Fulcrum
Items.Description: A mid-sized fighter developed as a replacement for contemporary frontline aircraft such as the MiG-21. Its superlative turning ability makes it an excellent knife fighter. It was designed as a counter to the F-15 and other similar aircraft. It is widely known by the codename "Fulcrum."

Items.Name: Su-57 Felon
Items.Description: A cutting-edge stealth fighter designed to succeed current air superiority fighters. Developed based on the PAK FA program, features such as the thrust-vectoring nozzles result in unmatched control. Its code name is "Felon."

Items.Name: F-16C Fighting Falcon
Items.Description: A low-weight fighter developed to, among other things, support large lead air superiority fighters. Featuring the latest technology of its time such as fly-by-wire, it boasts great dexterity and stability. Its nickname is "Fighting Falcon."

Items.Name: F-14D Super Tomcat
Items.Description: A large carrier-based fighter able to carry long-range anti-air missiles. Its automatic variable wings allow for superior combat at all speeds and altitudes. Its unofficial nickname, "Super Tomcat," is derived from the A-model.

Items.Name: F/A-18F Super Hornet
Items.Description: A carrier-based, twin-seat strike fighter developed as a redesign of the F/A-18. Major changes to the design of the airframe were made with the goal of providing greater cruising range and weapons payload capacity, and to account for the aircraft's increased size and stealth features.

Items.Name: F/A-18F Super Hornet
Items.Description: A carrier-based, twin-seat strike fighter developed as a redesign of the F/A-18. Major changes to the design of the airframe were made with the goal of providing greater cruising range and weapons payload capacity, and to account for the aircraft's increased size and stealth features.

Items.Name: F-15E Strike Eagle
Items.Description: A strike fighter that vastly improves upon the double-seater F-15. Nicknamed "Strike Eagle," this durable aircraft combines fundamental air combat capabilities with more weaponry than a standard fighter.

Items.Name: Su-47 Berkut
Items.Description: A large, multirole fighter whose unique forward-swept wings give it an instantly recognizable shape and a degree of maneuverability that surpasses all craft that came before it. Its nickname is "Berkut," meaning "golden eagle".

Items.Name: MiG-21bis Fishbed
Items.Description: A classically-designed small, low-weight fighter combining delta wings and horizontal tail wings. While its tricky controls ask a lot of the pilot, its incredible maneuverability has proven itself on the battlefield time and time again. Its nickname is "Fishbed."

Items.Name: Su-35S Flanker-E
Items.Description: A multirole fighter developed as a replacement for the existing fleet of frontline Su-27s. The improved maneuverability provided by its thrust-vectoring nozzles and cutting-edge avionics make it a highly capable dogfighter, rounded out with air-to-air and air-to-ground armaments which allow it to excel in long range engagements as well. Its codename is "Flanker-E."

Items.Name: MiG-31B Foxhound
Items.Description: A large interceptor that boasts high speeds on a world-class scale. It boasts long-range air-to-air missiles loaded with the latest avionics, as well as the ability to fly at high speeds in order to intercept cruise missiles.

Items.Name: Su-33 Flanker-D
Items.Description: A large fighter developed as a carrier aircraft from the famous Su-27. Canard wings, among other additions, improve stability and maneuverability at low-to-mid speeds. Although its reporting name is "Flanker-D," due to being carrier-based, it is also commonly referred to as "Sea Flanker."

Items.Name: EA-6B Prowler
Items.Description: An EW aircraft that is a significant redesign of the once cutting-edge A-6. Nicknamed "Prowler," it features a radome on the vertical tail's upper edge. Aside from using electronic interference and reconnaissance for support, it is also proficient in handling enemy defense networks.

Items.Name: F/A-18E Super Hornet
Items.Description: A single-seat multirole strike fighter able to carry out a wide variety of missions from fleet air defense to close air support, redesigned with extended range, increased payload capacity, and reduced RCS. Nicknamed "Super Hornet."

Items.Name: F-14A Tomcat
Items.Description: The initial model of the carrier-based fighter series that would later be upgraded to the "Super Tomcat." Its role of using long-range missiles to outrange and eliminate threats to the fleet has remained consistent from its creation. Its nickname is "Tomcat."

Items.Name: ADFX-02 Morgan -PIXY-
Items.Description: A large multirole aircraft used in an uprising by terrorists in A World With No Boundaries. Codenamed "Morgan," this versatile plane features high-output lasers, multi-purpose burst missiles, and more.
